name: The Ritz-Carlton Reynolds, Lake Oconee
insider_take: This lakeside Ritz-Carlton sits on Georgia's second-largest lake, where championship golf meets Southern hospitality in an unexpectedly serene setting just 90 minutes from Atlanta.
whats_special: The resort features two signature golf courses designed by Great Waters Course architect Jack Nicklaus and The Oconee Course by Rees Jones. Lake Oconee spans 19,000 acres with 374 miles of pristine shoreline, making it a haven for water sports enthusiasts. The property's Ritz Kids program includes unique activities like fishing clinics and nature walks through Georgia's piedmont landscape.
pro_tip: Book tee times for the Great Waters Course early morning to catch the mist rising off Lake Oconee – it's considered one of the most scenic golf experiences in the Southeast.
dont_miss: The sunset cruise aboard the resort's pontoon boat offers stunning views of the lake's countless coves and inlets. Visit nearby Madison, known as the "town Sherman refused to burn" during the Civil War, featuring preserved antebellum architecture just 20 minutes away.
pros: Stunning lakefront location on Lake Oconee with water activities
Championship golf course and comprehensive golf amenities
Luxury spa services and wellness facilities
Signature Ritz-Carlton service excellence and attention to detail
cons: Resort location requires travel to reach urban dining and entertainment
